description: Traffic Signal - AMD Completed Work is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. This shows the completed work actions for each work order added to the Traffic Signal Work Order starting from July 2022 to current within the City of Austin full jurisdiction. This work is managed by the Arterial Management Division (AMD) of the City of Austin Transportation and Public Works (TPW) department. Coverage: Austin. The portal files it under the category Transportation and Mobility. Its tags are completed work, complete, austin transportation, arterial management, amd. The table has 6 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
